summary: Relay the operator's usage hub quota to clients, and show it in a collapsible Usage section at the bottom of the web sidebar

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites. The relay holds one in-memory reading per refresh window.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes; no coordinated member upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: GET /v1/client/usage/quota is additive and requires read.projections. Existing routes and clients are unchanged. A web client on an older daemon receives 404 and says no quota source is configured.

downtime.detail: No startup work. Reads are bounded to one outbound request per refresh window with a five-second deadline.

manual.detail: Optional: to show quota, set [usage_hub] url in the daemon config after upgrading. A daemon older than this release refuses a config file that sets the key. No re-pairing or restart is needed; without the key the route reports disabled.

recovery.detail: Remove [usage_hub] from the config before swapping back to an older daemon, which would refuse the unknown key. No persistent state changes.
